Keep partial database contexts free of reporting beans; preserve the existing health identity. Update the verified reactor inventories and feature DAG. Regression and full-reactor structural checks pass.
* test(reporting): verify contributed template resource ownership
* feat(plugins): executable SPI, atomic catalog and externally packaged Mermaid
* test(ci): retain required branches in stacked PR verification contract
* fix(plugins): preserve invocation identity and verify existing integration lanes
* feat(plugins): optional features, lifecycle and durable execution identity
Complete tasks 9–12 source changes with data-only capabilities, exact artifact/configuration bindings, backup prerequisites, packaging and enforced SDK/source boundaries. Independent-review fixes included; full CI acceptance remains pending.

* docs(plugins): align contributor guides with executable SDK contracts
Document open provider IDs, independent STARTUP transports, durable artifact/configuration binding and capabilities-owned format selection. Fix stale module paths and retain exact full-profile verification requirements.
* fix(plugins): preserve admission identity and cleanup in startup runtime
Carry the reviewed loader fixes into the startup-runtime PR: compare authoritative copied bytes before opening a loader and continue cleanup after linkage/service errors.
Scope the packaging profile's empty-selection tolerance to non-owning modules, while taxonomy-build explicitly fails on missing/empty tests. Positive evidence: 13 actual packaged/HTTP tests and 5 independently built Mermaid tests on the full stack. Negative control MissingPluginPackagingCanary fails at taxonomy-build. This PR's loader/catalog/report regression selection passes all 24 tests.
* fix(templates): preserve immutable ordered diffs and preview contract
Address the two review findings with a defensive order-preserving map snapshot and the contribution-based preview contract. Verified 28 template API/controller/contribution tests.
* docs(plugins): document dynamic lifecycle environment settings
* fix(plugins): parse exact artifact names without backtracking
* fix(plugins): validate complete archive names and parse model identity linearly
* fix(plugins): normalize model target identity without backtracking
* test(ci): retain verification for extracted plugin inputs
Include the template API in consumer workflow filters and plugin APIs, runtime and artifacts in the observability scope. Execute the real scope command in isolated Git fixtures under Maven and retain architecture gates.
RED: 19 expected assertion failures. GREEN: 259 tests, zero failures, errors or skips. Independent review follow-up addressed Git/shell environment isolation. Full CI on this commit remains required.
* ci: require the complete plugin packaging lifecycle
* test(ci): include plugin profile in the existing aggregate contract
* test(ui): wait for loaded decision report formats
Wait for the existing export readiness condition before selecting each format. Preserve all DOCX/HTML/JSON assertions and the existing timeout. Record the full plugin profile evidence and the canonical CI failure.
